purpose: Reject literal and percent-encoded dot segments inside /download/ before Cloudflare normalizes the request path, so the Worker never sees an already-collapsed traversal attempt.
rationale: Cloudflare normalizes RFC 3986 dot segments before a Worker reads Request.url. In-Worker validation alone therefore cannot observe the raw traversal form, so Candidate B requires this zone-level ingress control in addition to assertSafeAssetName().

rule.description: vcskill edge: block raw dot segments in /download/
rule.expressionTemplate: (http.host eq "{{hostname}}" and starts_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/download/") and (raw.http.request.uri.path contains "/../" or raw.http.request.uri.path contains "/./" or raw.http.request.uri.path contains "%2e%2e" or raw.http.request.uri.path contains "%2E%2E" or raw.http.request.uri.path contains "%2f" or raw.http.request.uri.path contains "%2F" or ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/..") or ends_with(raw.http.request.uri.path, "/.")))
